changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A review's producer can also be TEAM, for a team-owned item, or OBSERVATIONS, with no composed feedback (ADR 0160, ADR 0165). Both producer columns accept exactly the five values.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE public.review DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_feedback_producer, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_feedback_producer CHECK (feedback_producer IS NULL OR feedback_producer IN ('LEGACY', 'MENTOR', 'WORK_PLACE'))
ALTER TABLE public.review_job DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_feedback_producer, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_feedback_producer CHECK (feedback_producer IN ('LEGACY', 'MENTOR', 'WORK_PLACE'))
